title: PHASE2 — Achiri conversation analytics dashboard data export
description: Export Achiri conversation analytics as structured JSON for a future web dashboard. Aggregates: DAU from daily-counts.json, engagement from daily-engage-log.jsonl, session count from session-logs/, user tiers from user-tiers.json, waitlist size from waitlist.jsonl. Writes to reports/achiri-analytics-export.json.

tasks.title: Create scripts/achiri/export-analytics.ts — dashboard data aggregator
tasks.description: Read workspace/achiri/daily-counts.json (DAU per day), daily-engage-log.jsonl (engagement events), session-logs/ (session count + avg messages), user-tiers.json (tier breakdown), waitlist.jsonl (waitlist size). Compute: total_sessions, unique_users (from engage log), dau_7d avg, top_days, tier_breakdown. Write to reports/achiri-analytics-export.json. Max 120 lines.
